items.name: formatters
items.title: Formatters
items.description: Locale-aware Intl-backed formatters (currency, date, datetime, relative time, number, percent, bytes) plus truncate and initials helpers. One place for every consistent string format in the app.

items.name: env-validator
items.title: Env validator (Zod)
items.description: Zod-validated server + client env loader. Fails fast at boot if anything required is missing or malformed. Import `env` everywhere instead of touching process.env directly.

items.name: client-only
items.title: ClientOnly
items.description: Defers rendering of children until after mount. Drop-in dodge for hydration mismatches when a child reads window / localStorage / navigator / Date.now() / Math.random().

items.name: invariant
items.title: invariant / assert / exhaustive
items.description: Dev-time assertion helpers with TypeScript narrowing. Replaces `if (!x) throw new Error()` boilerplate, narrows nullable values in-place, and catches missing switch cases at the type level.

items.name: rate-limit
items.title: rateLimit (Upstash)
items.description: Per-route rate limiter backed by Upstash Ratelimit. Uses the framework's locked Redis env vars. Cached limiter instances per (tokens, window) combination — call from any route without re-instantiating clients.

items.name: feature-flags
items.title: defineFlags + useFlag + FlagsProvider
items.description: Lightweight feature flags. Static FEATURE_* env flags + optional dynamic evaluator for per-user/org runtime checks. Client side uses a snapshot via <FlagsProvider> + useFlag().

items.name: soft-delete
items.title: withSoftDelete + softDelete + restore
items.description: Prisma client extension that auto-filters out rows where deletedAt is not null on findMany / findFirst / count. Plus tiny helpers to set / clear deletedAt. Pair with a `deletedAt: DateTime?` column + @@index([deletedAt]).

items.name: monitoring
items.title: captureError + captureMessage + logger + withErrorReporting
items.description: Adapter-pattern error / event monitoring shim. Defaults to a structured JSON-line console logger so it works on install; swap in Sentry / Axiom / Datadog with `setMonitoringAdapter`. Exposes captureError, captureMessage, logger.{info,warn,error,fatal,debug}, setMonitoringUser, setBaseContext, and a withErrorReporting handler wrapper.

items.name: db
items.title: db (Prisma client singleton)
items.description: Prisma client cached on `globalThis` so Next.js dev hot-reload doesn't open a fresh connection pool on every save. Imports from `./generated/prisma` (matching the no-src `output = '../lib/generated/prisma'` convention). One place to wire extensions (soft-delete, audit, tenantScope).
